title: Notification settings
description: The notification settings the runtime keeps (decision 0009; docs/notifications/telegram.md). Fields of the panel's settings (runtime-api.schema.json#/$defs/settings): GET /api/v1/settings answers them, POST /api/v1/settings writes the ones it carries and leaves the others as they were. A field never written answers its default.

telegramButtons.description: Shortcut buttons under gcx's Telegram messages (0009 Amendment 1): Stop bot, Close position, Retry, Retry order, Relaunch, the three TP/SL shortcuts. Off: new messages carry the panel link only, and a press on an older message answers "Shortcut buttons are off in Settings" and does nothing.

telegramConfirm.description: "Ask before a Telegram shortcut acts": the first press shows what the button will do, with Confirm and Cancel, for one minute; off, the first press acts. One switch for every button. A guard against a mistaken tap, not against another person.

notifyManual.description: Settings › Alerts › Manual orders placed from gcx (rulings 46): the Telegram message of a manual order's fill and of its trigger or trailing start. Off: those messages are not sent. A manual order's repair and alerts are always sent.

notifyOutside.description: Settings › Alerts › Orders placed outside gcx (rulings 46): a fill of an order placed outside gcx (the venue's own app or another tool) on a gcx account sends "fill (external)". Off: it does not. Seen while the account's stream is open.

notifyBotDefaults.description: Settings › Alerts › For new bots (rulings 46; 0009 d2): the notification switches a DCA bot gets when it is created, which the form shows and the person may change for that bot. Written whole. stops: bot stops or errors; tpSl: take-profit and stop-loss fills; fills: entry and averaging fills; fromLevel: those fills from this level on (0 is the entry order).
